title: The Forces of Darkness, LLC.
atmosphere: Evil enterprise meets everyday office dysfunction.
description: Raids, curses, dungeons, and impossible growth targets. An orc workforce, a dragon manager, necromancer HR, and one reluctant knight try to keep a genuinely evil fantasy enterprise running.
worldPremise: At the Forces of Darkness, LLC., conquest is a business. Kingdoms must be subdued, captives processed, spells audited, and every employee is still required to complete the annual performance review.
seriesEngine: Real fantasy evil collides with middle-office systems and ordinary people struggling with extraordinary immorality.
coreConflict: The Dark Lord expects competent growth in darkness; everyone below him just wants to survive another working day.
readerEntry: Read the newest daily strip, or start with number one and work through the archive. Unreleased strips never appear in the public reader.
audiencePromise: Deadpan fantasy workplace satire grounded in actual dark operations.

homepage.hook: Village raids, HR complaints, and a dragon manager who says the office is a family.
